title: Chapter 191 The Destined One
content:
Chapter 191 The Destined One

"The cultivation limit of Celestial Silkworm's Nine Transformations Technique can reach nine stars. With the help of the zerg Celestial Silkworm, the cultivation speed is extremely fast and the cultivator's cultivation qualifications can be gradually improved!"

"This is a technique specially created by our Zerg master to deal with the current situation. If you are interested in becoming a successor, regardless of your identity, you can come to me to test it to see if you are destined to inherit it!"

After arriving at the square, the captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knights used a loudspeaker to spread these words from a distance, not caring about the Tengu clan's reaction.

After saying this only once, the captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knights no longer paid attention to the reactions of others, but asked Gou Shu beside him: "Gou Shu, do you want to switch to the Celestial Silkworm Nine Transformations Cultivation Technique?"

Gou Shu did not hesitate and said respectfully: "Please give me the inheritance, Lord Tiancanknight!"

The captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knights took out a Celestial Silkworm and handed it to Gou Shu: "If you swallow the Celestial Silkworm, you will automatically receive the inheritance. The Celestial Silkworm has a spirit, so you must treat it with sincerity!"

"Yes! I will treat you sincerely!"

Gou Shu took one look at the exquisite celestial silkworm beeswax, which was as exquisite as a work of art, then put it in his mouth and swallowed it in one gulp.

Tiancan instantly established a spiritual connection with Gou Shu. Gou Shu sat cross-legged on the spot and began to receive the inheritance information of the digestion technique.

Gou Shu's strength has not yet reached star level, he can only be regarded as an ordinary elite soldier, and cannot accept the inheritance as easily as Meng.

"Sir, Sir Knight of Celestial Silkworm, please see if I am destined to receive the inheritance?"

Gou Shu's little fiancée, who had been watching from the side, suddenly asked in a low voice to the captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knights.

The captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knights looked at Gou Shu's little fiancée seriously and said, "You are the one who is destined, are you sure you want to get the inheritance?"

"I'm sure!"

The little girl from the Dog Clan answered very firmly this day.

The captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knights looked at the little girl's relatives again, and seeing that they were silent, he took out a Celestial Silkworm and handed it to this extraordinary little girl from the Tengu tribe.

The little girl from the Tengu clan looked at the Tiangu silkworm in her hand lovingly. She admired it for a long time before reluctantly swallowing it. Like Gou Shu, she sat cross-legged and accepted the inheritance.

Gou Shu and his young fiancée unconsciously began to practice the Nine Changes of Heavenly Silkworm technique. With the help of the Heavenly Silkworm in their bodies, a large amount of external energy was absorbed by them, and people nearby could clearly feel the energy around them. fluctuation.

In the square, the words of Captain Tiancan Knight attracted many people, and everyone was discussing whether what he just said was true or false.

"I don't believe that this Zerg is willing to use a powerful technique that can reach nine stars and improve your training qualifications! This technique must be fake!"

"If there is such a technique that can quickly increase strength, then aren't all the strong people in this world? They are either bragging about the ability of the technique, or this technique has great side effects!"

"This is still an insect parasitism technique. Who knows what kind of intentions this insect race has. Such a technique, no matter how good it is, cannot be practiced!"

"Look! I even found two trustees! Sure enough, they are a race that has just entered the world, and their routines are so unoriginal!"

"This Zerg is really too high-profile and not lovable!"

"..."

After all, this is the city of the Tengu Clan. Many people will not believe what the Zerg Celestial Silkworm Knight said, who made the Tengu Clan lose face, and will slander them in every possible way.

After hearing these words, the Heavenly Silkworm Knights didn't care. This Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations Technique is a great opportunity for most people. It really takes a fate to inherit it.

These people who are against the Zerg are the people who have no destiny.

Practicing the Nine Changes of Heavenly Silkworm technique means that you have a great cause and effect with the Zerg. As long as you don't intentionally harm Wu Qing's interests, the Zerg will not use any of its methods.

With the improvement in strength brought about by practicing the Nine Transformations of the Heavenly Silkworm, and the causal relationship with the Zerg and other people who practice the Nine Transformations of the Heavenly Silkworm, no matter what environment you are in, your original destiny will change.

It was still early, and the transport host sent by Wu Qing to pick up Gou Shu and their two families had not yet arrived, and the Celestial Silkworm Knights were waiting patiently.

Because of the words of the Celestial Silkworm Knight, more and more people of all kinds gathered in the square. Believe it or not, this was at least the voice of a newly wealthy family who had just joined the world. It would be a good idea to come and see the excitement.

"Dear Sir Celestial Silkworm Knight, please help me test it to see if I am destined to receive the inheritance!"

A boy from the rabbit tribe who had been wandering around the Celestial Silkworm Knight for a long time finally plucked up the courage and walked up to the Celestial Silkworm Knight squad leader under the strange gazes of others and asked respectfully.

From the clothing of this rabbit boy, it can be seen that he is a refugee living here, and he belongs to the lowest level of people in the city.

The captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knight looked at the boy from the rabbit tribe, his eyes narrowed slightly, and a powerful mental oppression that only the boy from the rabbit tribe could feel came over him like a mountain.

The rabbit boy's face turned pale and he was sweating profusely, but he still gritted his teeth and persisted without retreating.

"When was the last time you had a full meal? How did you get enough food?"

The voice of the captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knights sounded in the ears of the rabbit tribe boy.

The boy from the rabbit tribe subconsciously answered: "I had a full meal two days ago because I ran fast and helped a lady from the Tengu tribe recover her pet. She rewarded me with food!"

"When was the last time you hit someone? Why did you hit them?"

"The last time I beat someone was just now. Someone from a gang wanted to capture us and sell us to a caravan. I kicked my captor and ran here!"

"..."

The Silkworm Knight exerted appropriate mental oppression on the Rabbit boy, making him unable to think normally and answer several questions subconsciously.

These questions were asked by the Queen of the Insects. It can analyze and evaluate the people who come to test their fate by asking a few simple questions according to different people. Only those who meet certain standards can obtain the inheritance of the Silkworm Nine Transformations.

This standard was set by Wu Qing. Of course, people who Wu Qing doesn't like can't be allowed to inherit. With the development speed of the Zerg, these people who practice the Silkworm Nine Transformations will eventually return to the Zerg. Wu Qing doesn't want to see people he doesn't like appear under his command.

After asking the Rabbit boy several questions, the captain of the Silkworm Knight stopped the mental oppression and let the Rabbit boy return to normal.

The Rabbit boy woke up. Facing a strong man who made him lose the ability to think with a glance, he became more respectful and full of yearning for powerful power in his heart.

"You are destined to inherit, and you can get the inheritance!"

"Obtain my Zerg inheritance. When you encounter difficulties, you can use the Sky Silkworm to sense other inheritors around you and seek help!"

"If you meet someone from my Zerg, you can also ask for help!"

"Please help other inheritors if you can!"

"As inheritors, we need to support each other and not kill each other!"

"Can you do it?"

The captain of the Sky Silkworm Knights said slowly, looking at the ecstatic Rabbit boy.

He did not lower his voice, and many people watching nearby could hear him. Many people watching knew this Rabbit boy.

"I can do it!"

The Rabbit boy promised excitedly.

The captain of the Silkworm Knights took out a silkworm and handed it to the rabbit boy: "Remember, the silkworm is spiritual, you need to treat it with sincerity! The effect of the silkworm's auxiliary cultivation will be very different if you are sincere or not!"

"The inheritance can only be used by yourself, you can accept the inheritance here!"

"Yes! Lord Silkworm Knight!"

The rabbit boy calmed down his excitement, found a place to sit cross-legged next to Gou Shu, swallowed the silkworm, and began to close his eyes to accept the inheritance.

People with a certain strength can clearly sense that the rabbit boy, who originally had no traces of cultivation, soon had a strong energy fluctuation.

"I know this guy. He was just being chased by someone. Is he a shill?"

"He has gained the inheritance and has become famous so quickly?"

"I haven't seen any adverse reactions from him. His temperament is slightly different!"

"Strong men sent by a large tribe like the Zerg should not speak nonsense, right? If it is proved later that what they said was all false, how can such a large tribe be trusted in the future?"

"I heard that the Zerg is famous for its honesty. Many lords in the Tengu tribe's sphere of influence have received favors from the Zerg on the battlefield and have a good impression of the Zerg!"

"With this rabbit boy taking the lead, many people in similar situations should give it a try!"

"Nominally, you can rely on the Zerg, a large tribe, and you can also form a group with other inheritors. This alone can attract many people!"

"..."

The views of many people around began to change.

Sure enough, with the leading role of the rabbit boy, especially after listening to the words of the captain of the Silkworm Knights, many people who had difficulty surviving had the courage to step forward and ask for a test.

Ten silkworm knights worked together to test those who wanted to obtain the inheritance. Except for some people who were found to have serious problems with their character, most of them successfully passed this so-called fate test.

The team that obtained the inheritance grew stronger. So many people gathered together and couldn't help but practice the Silkworm Nine Transformations. Even if their strength was very low, they also attracted the energy between heaven and earth and produced a weak vision.

Just as more people were about to go forward to try, a huge monster suddenly appeared in the sky!

The transport host with a diameter of more than 30 meters descended domineeringly!

The transport host located the position of the silkworm knight, entered the city area from high altitude, and then lowered the altitude to perfectly avoid the guards of the Tengu tribe.

When the guards in the city discovered this huge monster coming from the sky, the transport host had already taken the initiative to turn off the stealth talent and was on the stage in a high profile.

This gave people the feeling that this huge monster suddenly appeared above the square in the city, and no one could see where it came from.

A large number of Tengu defenders in the city began to mobilize, and the army in the entire city entered a state of alert!
